profile.headline: Remote Haskeller
profile.summary:
I'm a professional Haskell backend engineer. If you need some servers to do stuff, correctly - I'm your guy.

I also do some Haskell gamedev on the side. My games are here: https://ldjam.com/users/macaroni-dev/games

And the Nix library I use to cross-compile my games to Windows is open-sourced here: https://gitlab.com/macaroni.dev/macaroni.nix

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Haskelling in the back of the stack - where Mercury interacts with the greater banking world.

I've primarily been working on reconciliation since  its inception at Mercury. I've also done various systems work on core banking backend workflows.

positions.title: Cofounder
positions.description:
Recruiting tooling with an emphasis on chat and candidate experience.
Built with Go, Nix/NixOS, Postgres, Elm, and Haskell (Shpadoinkle).

positions.title: Lead AI Engineer
positions.description: Used Haskell, Nix, and Kotlin to automate & optimize Target's supply chain.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Worked on various Haskell & crypto-related projects.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: I designed, built, and supported various Haskell web services that powered personalized Starbucks Rewards offers (including parts of their customer-facing mobile app)

positions.title: Software Development Engineer
positions.description:
I was part of the AWS Infrastructure Automation organization. My specific team worked to automate and optimize AWS's supply chain in areas such as component (RAM, CPU, etc) supply/demand and logistics.

I mostly wrote Scala with Scalaz.

honors.title: Best Abstract in Category
honors.issuer: Issued by Purdue University Undergraduate Research Poster Symposium · Mar 2013

projects.title: BoilerReversi (Senior Design)
projects.description:
Physical, interactive Othello board - powered by Haskell on a Raspberry Pi :)

YouTube demo: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Jm9Sheqgor4
Github: https://github.com/orgs/BoilerReversi/

projects.title: General Game Playing Monte-Carlo Tree Search
projects.description:
Semester project for ECE 570: Artificial Intelligence

Written in Clojure with core.logic (a port of miniKanren)

Github https://github.com/ramirez7/ggp-mcts
